title: Force 2D Items
description: Forces dropped items to render in 2D
body:
This mod forces dropped items to render in 2D, even with Fancy graphics enabled.

**NOTE: This mod is for Minecraft versions 1.4.6 through 1.7.10. If you want 2D items in 1.21.11+, use [Old 2D Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/old-2d-items) instead.**
